LanguageData.BOR_Crewmates.label: crewmates
LanguageData.BOR_Crewmates.description:
A vastly improved version of the more common recreational drinks which involve the use of Sunweave, Tenebrite is substituted instead of common water and draws out immensely pleasurable compounds from within the powdered Sunweave. Like all drugs based upon Sunsteel, there is a small risk of addiction - though the addition of Tenebrite seems to have lowered it even further.
This specific formula is often used aboard small-population transport ships to dull the monotony of their day-to-day maintenance.
